name: elk-english-coach
description: ELK English Learning Coach: fully self-contained, distributable IELTS preparation assistant. Ships its own schemas, rubrics, prompt templates, and sample question pack inside the package. Zero-dependency Python core (stdlib only) — no pip install, no .venv, no environment variables. Copy to any machine with Python 3.10+ and it works.

displayDescription.en: Out-of-the-box IELTS English coach: self-initializes environment, manages question banks, retrieves real questions, and scores writing/speaking with self-authored rubrics.
displayDescription.zh: 开箱即用的雅思教练：自动初始化环境，管理题库，检索真题，用自研标准评分改进，覆盖听说读写全流程备考。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我初始化 ELK 学习环境并检查题库状态
defaultInitPrompt.en: Initialize the ELK environment and check the question bank status

quickPrompts.en: Initialize the ELK environment and check the question bank status
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我初始化 ELK 学习环境并检查题库状态

quickPrompts.en: Pick 3 reading passages from the bank for me to practice
quickPrompts.zh: 从题库挑 3 篇阅读真题让我练

quickPrompts.en: Score my essay using the official rubric and suggest improvements
quickPrompts.zh: 用评分标准给我的作文打分并给出改进建议
